caption: The drawing depicts an architectural structure that appears to be a water feature or pool, shaped like a quatrefoil with four rounded lobes connected to form a symmetrical outline. The object is primarily light beige or off-white in color, with red decorative elements. The edge of the structure is capped with a red border that looks like stone or tile, segmented by lines suggesting individual pieces. A red wavy line runs around the perimeter of the vertical surface, both near the top and midway down the sides. The interior is filled with blue-green water. The object is set against a plain, unadorned background. There is a signature, "Geoffrey Holt," on the right-hand side near the bottom.
title: Mission Fountain
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
